title: Q3 budget review - Transcript
content:
Q3 budget review - Transcript
2026-11-02 08:00
Attendees: Maria Lopez, Alex Novak

00:00:12 Maria Lopez: Thanks, Alex. The Q3 budget closes this week.
00:01:05 Maria Lopez: I need your platform cost estimate by Wednesday, 4 November.
00:01:40 Alex Novak: Should it include the new load test environment?
00:02:10 Maria Lopez: No. Let's keep it to cloud and tooling only.
00:02:25 Alex Novak: Agreed, cloud and tooling only. I will send it to you on Wednesday.
00:02:40 Alex Novak: I will also ask Petra for the tooling license costs by tomorrow, Tuesday.
00:02:50 Maria Lopez: Good. I still owe you the confirmed budget deadline for the board. I will send it to you by Thursday.
00:03:20 Alex Novak: Great, thanks.
[Transcript ended]
